title: 'Your Business Will Be Removed From Google' — Unless You Pay $700
one_paragraph_summary: Dustin Pillonato and Justin Ramsey ran Pointbreak Media, which robocalled more than 74 million people — including 14 million numbers on the Do Not Call Registry — falsely warning small business owners that Google was about to mark their business 'permanently closed' unless they pressed 1 to speak to a 'Google specialist' and pay $300 to $700 to 'claim and verify' their listing, then upsold a bogus $949.99 search-ranking guarantee. The FTC won summary judgment and courts ordered Pillonato and Ramsey to pay more than $3.3 million.
victim_type: small business owners with Google Business listings
dollar_amount_if_any: $3.3 million+ ordered against the two main defendants
named_parties: Dustin Pillonato; Justin Ramsey; Aaron Michael Jones; Vincent Yates; Pointbreak Media, LLC; DCP Marketing, LLC; Modern Source Media, LLC; National Business Listings, LLC; AllStar Data, LLC
why_it_hooks: A robocall tells you Google is about to delete your business — the only real threat is the call itself.
verification_notes: Strong primary documentation: complaint, final order, and two press releases all on ftc.gov. Exact per-defendant dollar breakdowns are in the final order PDF and should be pulled precisely rather than repeating the rounded $3.3M figure for any specific-number claim in the script.
